entries.msgstr: Elite status is given to vehicles with all available modules, Upgrades, and technical branches researched, including the vehicle(s) from the subsequent tier. Combat XP earned in Elite vehicles can either be converted to Free XP for gold or used to accelerate crew training.

After receiving Elite status, the vehicle starts earning Elite Points and receiving Elite Levels that represent your dedication to a specific vehicle. A corresponding Chevron is displayed in battle after you receive the first Elite Level.
Receive exclusive rewards for Tier XI vehicles including a unique volumetric style, Stat Tracker, and gun sleeve!
